text: Just had a peaceful morning. Coffee, sunlight on the table, nowhere to be. I read two pages of a book I actually like and listened to the street wake up. Nothing happened. It was enough.
Thank you for staying late to help me with this. I know it wasn't your job, and you did it anyway. I hope you get a quiet weekend, and I owe you a coffee.
Great. Another delay. Love that for me. I especially enjoy standing on a platform at 7:40 in the morning, admiring the information board that says nothing at all. Truly world-class service.

Per our last conversation, I remain confident in the direction of the project. I would, however, like to flag that the timeline has moved twice without a corresponding update to the scope. I am sure this is simply an oversight.
THAT'S IT. I AM ABSOLUTELY FURIOUS. I have asked three times, I have been ignored three times, and I will not tolerate this any longer. This is not a mistake anymore. This is a decision.
Va bene. Non importa. Davvero. Ho aspettato tutto il pomeriggio, ma evidentemente mi sono sbagliato. Non è la prima volta e probabilmente non sarà l'ultima. Buona serata.
I'm not angry. I'm just disappointed.
The report is on the table. The meeting is at nine. Please bring the printed copy.
I can't believe they cancelled again. This is getting ridiculous. I've been waiting for three weeks.
I love this city in the rain. The streets smell like coffee and wet stone, and nobody is in a hurry.
We need to talk. I'm not sure this is working anymore. I don't want to fight, but I can't keep pretending.
Ha. Sure. That's exactly what I needed today.
